native.status: Summarize current revision, approvals, blockers; read-only
native.capabilities: List native capabilities and limits; read-only
native.record import: Validate and create/update content records atomically
native.evidence import: Copy authorized safe payloads, hash, store source metadata
native.evidence forget: Tombstone evidence, delete payload and derivatives, mark dependents stale
native.ingest plan: Emit/freeze bounded host-acquisition plan, no crawling
native.ingest import: Validate adapter results with original/derivative provenance
native.ingest extract: Turn host-saved files into evidence record plus extracted text
native.query: Metadata-first search by kind with coverage counters
native.packet: Create bounded immutable task packet within byte cap
native.verify: Rehash required payloads and verify state/dependencies
native.check plan create: Persist a required check plan with scoped rows
native.check result record: Record actual check observations against a plan
native.review create: Record a review packet with findings and limitations
native.decision record: Validate an owner decision and store it pending; a one-time code appears only on the owner's terminal (requires --owner)
native.decision confirm: Confirm a pending decision with the owner's terminal code; stores the attested decision
native.logo inspect: Limited static-SVG structural inspection (no optical judgment)
native.logo proof: Render SVG proofs via resvg worker with an isolated worker: in-process memory cap, 10 s timeout, macOS seatbelt / Linux ulimit
native.logo review-packet: Frozen proofs, inspection findings and SVG hash for review (no verdict)
native.color check: Advisory WCAG/APCA/CVD colour-pair analysis for logo colours
native.test plan: Persist validated/frozen test protocol from request file
native.test packet: Neutral stimuli/protocol projection for a test plan
native.test import: Import actual test observations and limitations
native.test summarize: Deterministic counts, gaps, and recorded interpretations; no causal inference
native.patch: Typed content-record add/replace/remove with dry-run preview or apply; never approves
native.review-packet: Freeze inspectable inputs with privacy filter, excluding builder rationale

host_guided.crawling: Authorized web crawling via host browser or tools
host_guided.document_search: PDF reading, OCR, document search via host tools
host_guided.interviewing: Evidence synthesis and interviewing via host interaction
host_guided.strategy: Brand strategy, essence, platform via host reasoning
host_guided.naming: Naming brief and candidate screening; no legal clearance
host_guided.voice: Voice and tone development via host writing
host_guided.visual_direction: Visual territory direction via host design tools
host_guided.design: Identity system design via host design tools
host_guided.audience_testing: Actual audience testing via host recruitment
host_guided.expert_review: Independent expert review via host engagement
host_guided.optical_refinement: Optical refinement in a suitable vector editor
host_guided.logo_proof_render: Rendered proof via host renderer with provenance

unavailable.pdf_parser: No native PDF parser; host-guided only
unavailable.model_gateway: No model/API gateway in this alpha
unavailable.delta_packet: Delta-packet mode deferred; full packets only
unavailable.production_certification: No production-ready certification in this alpha
